000225sec-attribute-typesSTANDOC_48 (generic warning) Hanging paragraph in clause
<clause id="_fcae2afe-df4a-d0e8-539e-eb0826ae17cf" anchor="sec-attribute-types" obligation="normative">
<title id="_1411de46-dc6c-7a9b-0e40-2d04850174d5">Attribute Types</title>
<p id="_b01cc210-683d-3b78-6b3e-c19e2a8cff1c">The Rights, Restrictions, Responsibility and Party structure effectively provides attributes to the S-121 feature types by reference.</p>

<p id="_3185ae8a-3b91-63fe-9a8b-4eb7805a4a56">The S121_FeatureUnit is a feature type and may take on any of the feature attributes described in the Feature Concept Dictionary Register. Specific attributes are bound to specific features in the Product Specification. Figure 3-1 shows S121_FeatureUnit and its attributes.</p>
2

000319sec-feature-catalogue-entriesSTANDOC_48 (generic warning) Hanging paragraph in clause
<clause id="_956f2ab3-333b-1550-2e57-968a85082021" anchor="sec-feature-catalogue-entries" obligation="normative">
<title id="_51821d3b-dcfa-fb83-f219-97c4091f7fee">Feature Catalogue Entries</title>
<p id="_2a210d88-1b80-21e5-7eb0-71c134190e7b">The objects and attributes identified for use in the S-121 Product Specification are described in conformance with the IHO Geospatial Information (GI) Registry.<note id="_e91da4d9-1a39-7dd7-6cba-88035f7fb526"> <p id="_c08d20e2-3bd9-bd5f-71fd-9ff662139a1f">In this version 1.0.0 of the S-121 Product Specification the following tables constitute the Feature Catalogue as a document. These tables will then be entered into the IHO GI Registry and a subsequent version of the Feature Catalogue will be generated from the Registry. These tables in a subsequent version of the S-121 Product Specification will also be generated from the Registry. This process ensures complete alignment between the Feature Catalogue, the Registry and this document.</p>
</note> </p>
